name: M Blade
_about: M Blade, traced off a photo of a BMW M cluster (Nov 14 2026; the photo was warped to the panel and measured), generated by tools/gen_mblade_navi.py (edit that and regenerate): the speed scale as a cyan line with a knee on the left (a marker at the speed), a blue hexagon in panels with the gear letter big in the void across it (D, or S / M by the shifter programme, P R N) and the speed small right under it with km/h (the drive mode on the four tabs under it, the battery's power in kW under the speed when eDrive Live shares it), the red rev blade on the right (0..7000 rpm, the stock-style shift light at the top), the fuel strip bottom left and, bottom right, two aligned strips: the oil temperature (blue under 75 deg, green warm, red flashing over the limit) and the hybrid battery in %. Along the bottom row, in one lettering: the clock and the fuel range at the left, the outside temperature at the right, clear of BMW's belt light (x 587..626, y 663..700); a row of sensors just above (y 622): the oil temperature and the electric range, each centred under its strip, and the coolant temperature at the far right over the outside one. Waze's map normally sits at the centred 1088x480 of the panel; Waze on the cluster 0.9.107 or later takes a window from shared/map_window.js (map_window.txt) and this layout asks for a window centred on the slot's middle, where Waze puts the car (x 735..1185, y 128..578) when 'Show Waze map inside the theme' is on. The theme is then rebuilt (backdrop_open and the o_ readouts): the hexagon smaller at the left with the gear and the speed in its void, the blade and the strips (with the oil and electric range under them) to the right, the speed scale gives way to the map and the vertical fuel strip becomes a flat bar under the map (pump icon, 0 / 1/2 / 1) with the fuel range beside it. Without the map a view (tools/add_sensor_bars.py) opens in a blue panel on the left in place of the speed scale, the hexagon carried on to a point (mpanel), the fuel strip right of the battery's with its range under it. Nothing is drawn under the map. Clear of the black box BMW draws at x 1406..1597, y 322..440. Widget reference: shared/hud.js header.
